localChanges: The new interface is now the default, in the Slate and brass theme (#735). If you chose an interface or theme in Options, your choice is kept.
Enter now goes through whatever still needs you, and ends the turn once nothing is left. Shift+Enter skips to the next item.
The classic interface is still there for now: choose it under Interface in Options, or add ?interface=classic to the address. The Civ1 classic theme is staying, under Theme in Options.
